claim_scope: developmental broad offensive relative-shape recovery under fixed synthetic assumptions

diagnosis.maps: actual shape truth, outer-mean fitted shape and bias on one shared scale; attempts/60 team minutes
diagnosis.accounting: native volume, shape and signed cross-term squared-error contributions; same fitted volume-only comparator
diagnosis.mechanism: twelve-region squared bias versus sampling variation, all saved outer datasets; point versus weighted scale/interval behavior

recovery.means: eight paired broad-shape error comparisons with denominators and monte carlo intervals
recovery.intervals: four primary coverage cells; nominal .95 distinct from developmental .90 floor; transition/null/stress limits visible
recovery.early_stop: unreached claims labeled not_run with the exact stopping reason; no fabricated candidate maps

representation_limits.maps: actual truth, geometric projection and fitted broad/local/rough shapes; gaussian outer zero, year five; shared scales
representation_limits.real: only conditional fixed real examples; research point associations, no real refit intervals

point_diagnostics.estimands: actual shape and complete rates; geometric projected truth is not the assessment target

limitations: shape allocation is separated from attempt volume; directional gain is not a practical accuracy margin
40 feet is a nominal basis wavelength, not demonstrated cell accuracy; omitted directions have no model variance
original native shares remain estimated but conditioned on and can imprint texture
refits vary fitted histories and scales, not sources, reference estimation, topology or cross-game dependence
two offensive patterns do not validate every player, defense shape, entrant, local or rough signal
nominal .95 pointwise intervals are assessed against a .90 developmental floor, not simultaneous calibration
inseparable individual players and their difference remain not_data_identified
native additive complete rates remain unconstrained; no clipping, intensity-model or causal claim
new real-player refit intervals, source/deployment robustness and supported chance valuation remain pending
no scientific result is a publication handoff
